components.name: appcore-ai
components.summary: Adaptive AI runtime boundary for model routing, local or remote inference, resource governance, provenance, security and observable execution.

components.name: appcore-sync-sqlite
components.summary: Optional bounded SQLite persistence for Runtime replication log, outbox, checkpoints, opaque tombstones, integrity and online backup.

components.name: appcore-filemaker
components.summary: Deterministic compiler for declarative documents, vector canvases and bounded datasets.

components.name: appcore-filemaker-ai
components.summary: Optional bounded appcore-ai tool bridge for deterministic FileMaker sessions.

components.name: appcore-filemaker-cli
components.summary: Bounded command-line process adapter for FileMaker compilation, diagnostics and export.

components.name: appcore-ui
components.summary: UI surface boundary for HTML/TypeScript pages, native Rust-rendered views, window lifecycle, events, visual state and future page building.

components.name: appcore-test
components.summary: Deterministic test harness with fake clock, storage, transport, peers, providers, AI, device/UI surfaces, fault injection and network simulation.

components.name: appcore-jobs
components.summary: Durable job lifecycle from Created to Queued, Running, Completed, Failed or Retry, separate from scheduler placement.

components.name: appcore-search
components.summary: Local-first search boundary for full text, metadata, filters, ranking and future lexical/vector/hybrid retrieval.

components.name: appcore-automation
components.summary: Deterministic Event to Condition to Action to Command automation with optional AI assistance and future visual editing.

components.name: appcore-plugin
components.summary: Static Rust composition boundary for providers, AI backends, UI components, device adapters and integrations.

components.name: appcore-media
components.summary: Common boundary for audio, video, capture, playback, encode/decode and streaming without promising specific codecs.

components.name: appcore-device
components.summary: Capability-controlled access boundary for USB, Bluetooth, serial, HID, sensors, camera, microphone, displays and accelerator discovery.

components.name: appcore-agent
components.summary: Goal, planning, tools, memory and action orchestration built on top of AI rather than mixed into the inference crate.

components.name: appcore-data
components.summary: Source to Decode to Validate to Transform to Batch/Stream to Sink data flow boundary, not a default ORM or dataframe layer.

components.name: appcore-cache
components.summary: Small bounded cache contract with TTL, eviction and metrics; not a Redis competitor.

components.name: appcore-runtime-sdk
components.summary: Ergonomic facade over existing runtime surfaces such as app.ai(), app.ui() and app.storage(), not a second runtime implementation.

components.name: appcore-events
components.summary: Event bus candidate only if further analysis proves event responsibility is dispersed enough to justify a separate crate.

components.name: appcore-config
components.summary: Layering candidate for defaults, file, environment, CLI and deployment config while leaving CLI ownership with appcore-args.

components.name: appcore-secrets
components.summary: Possible split from security only if secret resolution, rotation, scoping and audit need an independent owner.

components.name: appcore-sandbox
components.summary: Isolation boundary candidate; no sandboxing guarantees are claimed until an implementation and threat model exist.

components.name: appcore-browser
components.summary: Controlled browser and web automation research area, not a commitment to become a browser engine.

components.name: appcore-spatial
components.summary: Possible evolution of UI surfaces toward scene, XR, AR or VR concepts.

components.name: appcore-sim
components.summary: Deterministic simulation for clusters, devices, networks and pressure scenarios, distinct from unit test helpers.

components.name: appcore-cloud
components.summary: Deployment and orchestration abstraction research area, not a cloud provider and not a replacement for explicit providers.
